references.text: The genealogy of Korah shows that he was the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi. This confirms his Levitical descent.
Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, are mentioned here as those who rebelled against Moses and Aaron, referring back to the event in Numbers 16.
Reference to Korah's rebellion and those who gathered against the Lord in Korah's company.
Moses reminds the Israelites of what the Lord did to Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, son of Reuben.
The psalmist refers to the rebellion in the camp against Moses and Aaron, and how the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan and covered over Abiram's company.
Jude warns against those who have gone astray in Korah's rebellion (τῇ ἀντιλογίᾳ τοῦ Κόρε), using this as a warning example.
